_derivation.why: The Socrata census file cannot distinguish carrier authority from broker authority — classdef says AUTHORIZED FOR HIRE for both. Only QCMobile splits common/contract/broker, which is what makes this check possible at all.
_derivation.note: An entity holding only broker authority cannot legally haul freight. Tendering a load to one IS double-brokering, so this must resolve to authorizedForHire=false and block. GENERAL TRANSPORT INC really does hold carrier authority; this is a hand-built test input.
_derivation.replaceWhen: An FMCSA WebKey is obtained. Record a real broker-only entity and delete this file.
